prose: Google DeepMind published a repository for AlphaEvolve. It has a minimal implementation of AlphaEvolve with local evaluation, and an /omega directory with code and data for a new upper bound on the matrix multiplication exponent that AlphaEvolve found. A Colab notebook verifies it with rational arithmetic, and a level_3 folder holds the JAX/Haiku gradient-descent code (32k steps, 32 seeds) that converts the best solution into a verifiable parameter vector. The paper link is still a TODO.
highlights: Minimal AlphaEvolve implementation with local evaluation
New upper bound on matrix multiplication exponent, with verification
Rigorous Colab check uses rational arithmetic
